title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

title: Karoshi
overview: Described as a corporate thriller with a samurai twist. Set in a Japanese-influenced New York City and features a revenge element. Plot TBA.

title: Slayground
overview: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth — even if the trail leads straight back to him.

title: Порча. Лучшие друзья
overview: A young married couple is convinced that the terminal illness afflicting one of them is the result of a curse. They gather a group of close friends to uncover who cast it—and to put an end to the curse, no matter the cost.

title: Queen of France
overview: Russia, XI century. Grand Duke Yaroslav Mudryy gives his daughter Anna in marriage to the king of the Franks. Ostromir, a mercenary who previously served in the Varangian guard of the Emperor of Byzantium, must protect the princess on a dangerous journey across Europe. Along the way, Ostromir and Anna fall in love with each other.

title: Arnie & Barney
overview: A platoon of ants set out to save their community in the midst of a severe drought, but the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney – who are not cut out for heroics – decide to tackle the problem themselves. Their bumbling efforts lead them to uncover a shady water racket and team up with a secretive superhero mosquito. In a series of comical mishaps, they inadvertently save the meadow and become the most unlikely heroes of all.

title: Be My boyfriend
overview: "What would happen if I gave flowers to someone else?" This is the question Pasha, a courier from Sochi, asks himself on the eve of his wedding. Five years ago, he almost met the aspiring actress Yana, and now she is a superstar. The thought that they could have been together haunts Pasha, so for his bachelor party he decides to find out what would happen if he did give Yana flowers.

title: Папины дочки. Свадьбы не будет
overview: Big changes lie ahead for the Vasnetsov-Vasilyev family, including the wedding of Sonya and Igor. However, the couple’s plans are jeopardized when an influential figure opposes their union—someone prepared to go to any lengths to ensure the celebration never takes place. The family heads to Saint Petersburg, where they encounter chases, daring escapades, and unexpected challenges—all of which serve as a reminder of what matters most: a true family always sticks together.

title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: War and Peace
overview: Against the background of the war of 1812 and the conflicts preceding it, the fate of the Russian aristocracy unfolds.

title: Барабашка
overview: Masha, a schoolgirl, continues to believe in miracles, even though her family and classmates think she’s a bit eccentric. One day, she discovers a magic mirror and accidentally opens an ancient dungeon, unleashing malevolent creatures from a fairy-tale realm. Now, alongside a "Barabashka"—a guardian of magical balance—she must set off on an adventure to stop these uninvited guests and save the world.

title: Maslenitsa
overview: Polina and Olya have been friends since childhood. Polina lives for her studies, but her quiet life ends when the girl who dreams of going to study in China fails the selection for an exchange program. It seems that life has lost its meaning, but then an opportunity arises to fix everything: you just need to spend Maslenitsa week with a student from China, immersing him in our culture and introducing him to the traditions of seeing off winter. This student turns out to be the son of a high-ranking Chinese official, the arrogant Wang Yu with a difficult character, but nothing can stop Polina from using her last chance. Nothing, except a broken leg. Olya knows that studying in China is Polina's blue dream, so she immediately decides to help her friend by replacing her during Maslenitsa week.

title: Vanya
overview: Vanya doesn't know his father. His mother says he works in Moscow. With friend Fedya, Vanya meets Viktor, his mother's former classmate who lived in Germany, wondering if he's Vanya's dad as they prepare to search for him in Moscow.

title: Выжить во льдах
overview: Antarctica, early 1980s. Following an emergency at the Soviet polar station "Voshod," the crew finds themselves in an extreme situation: temperatures are plummeting to minus 70 degrees Celsius, they are surrounded by an icy wasteland stretching for thousands of kilometers, and immediate evacuation is impossible. The station chief, Serov, makes a series of unconventional decisions that threaten to trigger yet another catastrophe. Realizing this, Rodin—a member of the team—understands that to save his fellow crew members, he must defy orders and take responsibility for the team himself.
